final: WITH d AS (SELECT district_id AS did, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM account GROUP BY district_id), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM d WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL), s AS (SELECT d.did, d.cnt, CAST(d.cnt AS REAL)/t.total AS share FROM d JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s WHERE share IS NOT NULL) SELECT s.did AS district_id, s.cnt AS account_count, s.share AS district_share, s.share - a.avg_share AS diff FROM s JOIN a ON a.avg_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
